description: This file defines extension methods for the ILifecycleObservable interface, enabling subscription management for lifecycle observers, including creating disposable subscriptions with various configurations and observer diagnostics.

classes.name: LifecycleExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for subscribing to lifecycle observables with different configurations, including diagnostics and lifecycle management.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: A private nested class implementing ILifecycleObserver, used internally to encapsulate start and stop delegate logic.

classes.name: StartupObserver
classes.description: A private nested class implementing ILifecycleObserver, used to create a one-time startup observer that disposes itself after invocation.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Creates a disposable subscription to the lifecycle observable with specified start and optional stop delegates.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Overload for subscribing with only a start delegate.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Creates a subscription with a strongly-typed observer for diagnostics.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Creates a subscription with start and stop delegates, with diagnostics.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Creates a subscription with only a start delegate, with diagnostics.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Creates a subscription with a specified observer object.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method for creating a StartupObserver that subscribes and disposes itself after the first start.

methods.name: GetTypeName
methods.description: Utility method to get the full name of a type, or fallback to the type's name.
